'''Grohto''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]], Grohto was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]; obtaining the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and constructing a [[Color/Legends|green]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Grohto took up the rank of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. When the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] resurfaced during the war, Grohto was assigned to a strike team tasked with hunting down Maul and his brother, [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]. Along with Masters [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Bruu Jun-Fan]] and [[Ko Solok]], Grohto journeyed across the Republic following reports of the two [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabraks]]' deeds. [[Skirmish on Orto Norwe|Confronting]] the dark-siders on [[Orto Norwe]], Grohto was killed by Maul's lightsaber, sustaining a fatal blow to the abdomen after the Zabrak distracted the Jedi by using a Human woman as a living shield.<ref name="TSH" />
